description: Paid (0.01 USDC per call). Latest rental quotes for one GPU model across neo-clouds, marketplaces and other clouds. One row per quote in each provider's latest daily snapshot: provider, market (`ondemand`, `spot` = interruptible, `bid` = marketplace minimum bid, `secure`/`community` = RunPod tiers), GPUs in the quoted unit, USD per GPU-hour, quoted unit price, region where the provider exposes one, and provider-specific detail in `extra` (marketplace host reliability, VRAM, stock status). Sources are each provider's public price feed or page (Vast.ai: the cheapest 64 offers per model, on-demand and bid); /gpu/models lists who quotes each model. Snapshots are taken several times a day.

gpu.description: Normalized GPU model from /gpu/models, e.g. `H100 SXM`, `H200`, `B200`, `A100 SXM 80GB`, `L40S`, `RTX 4090`. Example: H100 SXM

provider.description: Restrict to one provider slug as listed by /gpu/models (for example `runpod`, `vast`, `lambda`).

name: gpu_quotes

anyOf.description: Provider-specific detail (offer id, host reliability, VRAM, stock).

extra.description: Provider-specific detail (offer id, host reliability, VRAM, stock).

market.description: ondemand; spot (interruptible); bid (marketplace minimum bid); secure/community (RunPod tiers); network (io.net network tier); executed (Nosana jobs that ran); lease (Akash active leases); rented (Vast offers inferred taken).

price_unit_hr.description: USD per hour for the quoted unit.

title: GPU rental quotes
